Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the state building code council regulation of equipment or systems used for commercial and industrial cold storage.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state building code council regulation ofequipment or systems used for commercial and industrial cold storage;amending RCW 19.27.065 and 19.27A.027; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to prohibit thestate building code council from adopting any mandates or rules relatedto equipment and processes used for cold storage. The council issupposed to make minimum standards related to safety for those thatoccupy buildings, not micromanage industrial or commercial processes.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.27.065 and 1996 c 157 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to: (1) Temporary growing structures used solely for the commercialproduction of horticultural plants including ornamental plants,flowers, vegetables, and fruits. A temporary growing structure is notconsidered a building for purposes of this chapter; (2) Equipment used for commercial or industrial cold storage.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.27A.027 and 1996 c 323 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (((1))) The state building code council shall exempt the followingfrom regulation under this chapter: (1) Equipment shelters of personal wireless service facilities frombuilding envelope insulation requirements. (((2) For the purposes of this section,)) "Personal wirelessservice facilities" means facilities for the provision of personalwireless services; (2) Refrigerated warehouse heating and cooling systems or equipmentused for cold storage spaces.
